faqs.q: How do Dried Cranberries taste compared to Dried Blueberries?
faqs.a: Dried Cranberries have a brighter, tangier tart-sweet bite, whereas Dried Blueberries are milder and more floral-sweet. Many customers enjoy mixing both with almonds and pumpkin seeds.

faqs.q: How much Dried Cranberry should I eat per day?
faqs.a: A standard daily portion is 1 to 1.5 tablespoons (15g–20g) eaten as a snack or added to oats, yogurt, or salads.

faqs.q: Are there any artificial red colors or sulphur preservatives?
faqs.a: No. The ruby color comes naturally from cranberry skin pigments (anthocyanins), with 0% artificial dyes and 0% sulphur dioxide.
